text.description_html:
Acorn RP7BP, Iron Cabinet Spear Tip Drawer Pull

Acorn's Rough Iron Spear Tip Cabinet Pull is great for light interior doors, cabinet doors, and drawers. It can easily be mounted vertically or horizontal and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. The spear tip cabinet drawer pull has a rough iron finish.

Rough Iron surface hardware duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron.

Features and Specifications of the Acorn RP7BP Spear Tip Collection Cabinet Door Pull:

  • Length (center to center): 3-9/16"
  • Overall Length: 5-1/8"
  • Mount Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Package includes 1 cabinet pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.

    • Sold Individually
